description: Grows and harvests fruits such as apples, oranges, and berries.
Cultivates and harvests vegetables like carrots, potatoes, and lettuce.
Manages cows for milk production and processes dairy products.
Raises sheep for wool, meat, and other products.
Performs physical tasks on construction sites, such as digging and carrying materials.
Lays bricks, concrete blocks, and stones to build walls and structures.
Constructs, installs, and repairs wooden frameworks and structures.
Installs, maintains, and repairs electrical systems in buildings and equipment.
Installs and repairs water, gas, and drainage systems in homes and businesses.
Designs, writes, and tests computer programs and applications.
Builds and maintains websites and web applications.
Analyses data and produces statistical reports for government.
